scope: Two external Nucleo controllers through custom transceiver boards; onboard G431 excluded
provenance: Source archived after the runs; offline reproduction matches both recorded tested binary hashes
preparatory_uart_note: One UART diagnostic error counter appears in two initial PAUSED reports before reset/start; not present in RUN or final records
latency_method: G474 DWT cycle difference from pre-enqueue sampling to validated echo polling, divided by nominal 16 MHz clock
bus_load_method: 2 * 2326.62 delivered frames/s * assumed bits/frame / 1000000; conservative stuffing allowance, not a measured utilisation
clock_source: Internal HSI on both controllers; no temperature/voltage tolerance qualification
g431_recovery: Operator-reported; verification log, exact image, UART capture, repair photo and measured continuity pending
